name: Natsume Mako
source:
A first year student. She was a member of the aviation club with the protagonist and Iroha in their previous school. Using that bond, she actively approaches the protagonist.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
